title.purpose: App name in the popover header, window titles.

body.purpose: Button labels, preset names, menu items.

caption.purpose: Axis labels, meter text, chips, band-card field names.

value.purpose: Any number that updates live: Fc, Gain, Q, dB, latency.

motion.name: bypass-fade
motion.purpose: Graph and curve fade when bypass toggles.

motion.name: spectrum-detector
motion.purpose: Spectrum bar ballistics; the view adds a 45ms interpolation between 30 Hz frames.

components.name: Card
components.description: Popover section surface: 5.5% primary tint with a 7% hairline, continuous 12pt corners.
components.css: .ds-card { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.055); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07); border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px; color: #fff; font: 12px -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; width: 320px; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 11px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.55); margin-bottom: 6px; } .ds-card-row { font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Switch
components.description: AccentSwitchStyle: 34x20 capsule, accent when on, 18% primary when off, white knob with a faint shadow.
components.css: .ds-switch { display: inline-block; cursor: pointer; } .ds-switch input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; width: 0; height: 0; } .ds-switch-track { display: block; width: 34px; height: 20px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.18); position: relative; transition: background 120ms ease-out; } .ds-switch-knob { position: absolute; top: 1.5px; left: 1.5px; width: 17px; height: 17px; border-radius: 50%; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 0.5px 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.25); transition: left 120ms ease-out; } .ds-switch input:checked + .ds-switch-track { background: #0a84ff; } .ds-switch input:checked + .ds-switch-track .ds-switch-knob { left: 15.5px; } .ds-switch input:focus-visible + .ds-switch-track { outline: 2px solid rgba(10,132,255,0.6); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Small Bordered Button
components.description: Native .bordered button at .small size; the only button style in the app.
components.css: .ds-btn { font: 12px -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #fff; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.10); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08); border-radius: 6px; padding: 3px 10px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms ease-out; } .ds-btn:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.14); } .ds-btn:active { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.20); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(10,132,255,0.6); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Value Field
components.description: Click-to-edit monospaced value with a quaternary fill and 4pt corners.
components.css: .ds-value { display: inline-block; font: 11px 'SF Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; color: #fff; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.10); border-radius: 4px; padding: 2px 4px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-value:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.14); } .ds-value:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(10,132,255,0.6); }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Capsule with quaternary fill and 10pt secondary text, used for format names and band count.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; font: 10px -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.55); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.10); border-radius: 999px; padding: 3px 8px; }

components.name: Band Card
components.description: 150pt editor card for one band; separator hairline, band-coloured 1.5pt border when selected.
components.html:
1 · Peak
Fc105 Hz
Gain-3.5 dB
Q0.70
components.css: .ds-band { width: 150px; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 8px; background: #1e1e1e; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.10); border-radius: 8px; color: #fff; font: 10px -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-band-selected { border: 1.5px solid #0a84ff; } .ds-band-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; margin-bottom: 6px; } .ds-band-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: #0a84ff; } .ds-band-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.55); margin: 3px 0; } .ds-band-val { font: 11px 'SF Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; color: #fff; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.10); border-radius: 4px; padding: 1px 4px; }

components.name: App Badge
components.description: 24pt accent square with a white bar-chart symbol; the only logo mark.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 24px; height: 24px; border-radius: 6px; background: #0a84ff; }

narrative.overview:
OnlyEQ should look like a utility Apple forgot to ship. Every colour is a system semantic colour that follows the user's accent and appearance; every typeface is San Francisco; every control is either a native SwiftUI control or a pixel-faithful stand-in for one. The app has no palette, no logo mark beyond an SF Symbol in an accent square, and no decoration. Brand lives in one place only: the frequency-response curve with the live spectrum breathing behind it, and the ten-colour band palette that ties graph handles to their cards.

Density is high and steady. The popover is four cards and a footer in a 360 point wide window at least 410 points tall, growing only with the system text size; the editor is a graph, a strip of small band cards, and two thin bars of controls. Text uses the system text styles from caption2 to body, values are monospaced, and nothing bounces. Controls are precise and restrained: a switch slides in 120 ms, bypass fades the graph in 150 ms, the spectrum attacks in 10 ms and releases over 400 ms, and that is the whole motion vocabulary.
keyCharacteristics: System accent and system label colours only; the app never defines a hue of its own outside the band palette.
Tonal layering, no shadows: cards are a 5.5 % tint with a 7 % hairline.
One custom control family (switch, boost slider, curve editor), each drawn to match AppKit.
Monospaced digits wherever a number can change.
Motion is short, eased, and tied to a state change, never decorative.

rules.name: The One Hue Rule
rules.body: Outside the band palette and the boost warning, the only chromatic colour on screen is the user's accent. Never introduce a second brand colour.

rules.name: The Tint, Not Paint Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are Color.primary at low opacity so they read correctly in both appearances and with any accent. Never fill a surface with a literal grey.

rules.name: The Monospaced Number Rule
rules.body: Any number that can change while visible is set in monospaced digits so the layout does not shift.

rules.name: The Two-Step Rule
rules.body: Adjacent hierarchy levels differ by one point size or one weight step, never both, and never more.

rules.name: The System Casts The Shadow Rule
rules.body: Only windows, popovers, sheets, and control knobs have shadows, and only the ones AppKit would draw. Do not add shadows to cards, nodes, or hover states.

dos: Do use Color.accentColor, .primary, .secondary, .tertiary, .quaternary, and NSColor semantic colours; that is how the app follows the user's accent and appearance.
Do set every live number in monospaced digits.
Do keep new controls native: .bordered buttons at .small, native menus, grouped forms in Settings.
Do tie any animation to a state change and keep it under 200 ms with an ease curve.
Do give every icon-only control an accessibility label and prefer text styles that scale with the system text size.
donts: Don't introduce a hex colour, a custom font, or a gradient outside the curve fill.
Don't add shadows to cards, nodes, hover states, or anything AppKit would draw flat.
Don't invent a second toggle look; a control that is on or off is a switch, a button toggle, or a checkbox, matching its neighbours on the same surface.
Don't let the popover change size; it is fixed so the spectrum can redraw without relayout.
Don't use the band palette for anything but bands.
